name: Lead Access Chain
query:
SELECT * FROM (
	SELECT l.creation AS "When:Datetime:170", 'Lead created' AS "Event:Data:170", l.lead_owner AS "Person:Link/User:220", l.owner AS "By:Link/User:200", '' AS "Detail:Data:420"
	FROM `tabCRM Lead` l WHERE l.name = %(lead)s
	UNION ALL
	SELECT v.creation, 'Owner changed', NULL, v.owner, REGEXP_SUBSTR(v.data, '\\["lead_owner",[^\\]]*\\]')
	FROM `tabVersion` v WHERE v.ref_doctype = 'CRM Lead' AND v.docname = %(lead)s AND v.data LIKE '%%"lead_owner"%%'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT t.creation, 'Assigned', t.allocated_to, t.assigned_by, IFNULL(t.assignment_rule, 'by a person')
	FROM `tabToDo` t WHERE t.reference_type = 'CRM Lead' AND t.reference_name = %(lead)s
	UNION ALL
	SELECT t.modified, CONCAT('Assignment ', t.status), t.allocated_to, t.modified_by, ''
	FROM `tabToDo` t WHERE t.reference_type = 'CRM Lead' AND t.reference_name = %(lead)s AND t.status <> 'Open'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT s.creation, 'Share given', s.user, s.owner, ''
	FROM `tabDocShare` s WHERE s.share_doctype = 'CRM Lead' AND s.share_name = %(lead)s
	UNION ALL
	SELECT c.creation, 'Share removed', NULL, c.owner, c.content
	FROM `tabComment` c WHERE c.reference_doctype = 'CRM Lead' AND c.reference_name = %(lead)s AND c.comment_type = 'Unshared'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT NULL, 'Now: personal access', p.person, NULL,
		CASE
			WHEN p.person = (SELECT lead_owner FROM `tabCRM Lead` WHERE name = %(lead)s) THEN 'Lead Owner'
			WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabToDo` t WHERE t.reference_type = 'CRM Lead' AND t.reference_name = %(lead)s AND t.allocated_to = p.person AND t.status <> 'Cancelled') THEN 'holds an assignment'
			ELSE 'LEFTOVER SHARE: not owner, no assignment'
		END
	FROM (
		SELECT lead_owner AS person FROM `tabCRM Lead` WHERE name = %(lead)s AND IFNULL(lead_owner, '') <> ''
		UNION SELECT allocated_to FROM `tabToDo` WHERE reference_type = 'CRM Lead' AND reference_name = %(lead)s AND status <> 'Cancelled'
		UNION SELECT user FROM `tabDocShare` WHERE share_doctype = 'CRM Lead' AND share_name = %(lead)s
	) p
) chain
ORDER BY `When:Datetime:170` IS NULL, `When:Datetime:170`, `Event:Data:170`
